title: UMG IR Graph Schema
description: Intermediate Representation routing graph. A projection of RuntimeSpec. Shows how cognitive routing occurred — which stacks fired, which lost, which blocks are on the active route, which are suppressed, and how bundles, merges, and lanes fit into the graph. Generated by projectIrGraph() pass.

runtime_id.description: RuntimeSpec runtime_id this graph was projected from.

nodes.description: All nodes in the routing graph. Includes active, suppressed, and off nodes.

edges.description: All edges in the routing graph.

active_route.description: Ordered list of node IDs on the active cognitive route from sleeve through to output.

suppressed_routes.description: One array per suppressed branch. Suppressed routes are preserved for explainability.

merge_nodes.description: Node IDs of type 'merge' in this graph.

bundle_nodes.description: Node IDs of type 'bundle' in this graph.

lane_nodes.description: Node IDs of type 'lane' in this graph.

IRNode.description: A node in the IR routing graph.

id.description: Unique node identifier within this graph.

label.description: Human-readable label for display. Typically includes type prefix: [DIRECTIVE] Honor Governance, [BUNDLE] Governance Core, etc.

authority_rank.description: MOLT authority rank for molt_block nodes. Null for structural nodes.

molt_type.description: MOLT type for molt_block nodes and merge nodes.

source_ref.description: Reference back to the RuntimeSpec structure this node was projected from.

suppression_reason.description: Why this node is suppressed. Null if not suppressed.

bundle_id.description: For nodes that originated from bundle expansion — the source bundle_id.

merge_id.description: For merge nodes — the merge_id from MergeResult.

lane_id.description: For lane nodes — the horizontal lane ID.

IREdge.description: A directed edge in the IR routing graph.

type.description: Edge type. contains: structural containment. activates: gate fires neostack. suppresses: gate or authority prevents activation. routes_to: neostack routes to neoblock. expands_to: bundle expands into neoblock. merges_into: blocks merge into merge node. conflicts_with: two nodes in conflict. governs: dominant block governs another. outputs_to: execution connects to output layer.

state.description: Whether this edge is on an active or suppressed path.

reason.description: Why this edge exists or why it is suppressed.

nodeTypeDefinitions.sleeve: Root node. Represents the compiled sleeve. Entry point for all routing.
nodeTypeDefinitions.gate: Trigger gate node. Evaluated by evaluateGates() pass. Active if conditions matched.
nodeTypeDefinitions.neostack: NeoStack node. Active if its gate fired. Suppressed if gate did not match.
nodeTypeDefinitions.neoblock: NeoBlock node. Active if parent NeoStack is active.
nodeTypeDefinitions.molt_block: Individual MOLT block. Active if parent NeoBlock is active and not suppressed by hierarchy.
nodeTypeDefinitions.bundle: Bundle expansion node. Represents a bundle being expanded into a NeoBlock.
nodeTypeDefinitions.merge: Merge result node. Represents a completed merge producing a composite MOLT type.
nodeTypeDefinitions.lane: Horizontal capability lane node. Active lanes participate in output resolution.
nodeTypeDefinitions.output: Output node. Represents the final resolved output blueprint.

edgeTypeDefinitions.contains: Structural containment: sleeve contains neostacks, neostacks contain neoblocks, neoblocks contain molt_blocks.
edgeTypeDefinitions.activates: A gate firing causes its target neostack to become active.
edgeTypeDefinitions.suppresses: A gate not firing, or a higher-authority block, prevents a target from activating.
edgeTypeDefinitions.routes_to: A neostack routes cognitive execution to a neoblock.
edgeTypeDefinitions.expands_to: A bundle expands its members into a target neoblock.
edgeTypeDefinitions.merges_into: Source blocks feed into a merge node producing a composite type.
edgeTypeDefinitions.conflicts_with: Two nodes have competing claims that require resolution.
edgeTypeDefinitions.governs: A dominant block holds authority over another block in vertical hierarchy.
edgeTypeDefinitions.outputs_to: The resolved execution path feeds into the output node.
